amendments.rule: redact-secret#925: one period directly after an address, at the end or before whitespace or a closing quote/bracket, is a right boundary outside the range.

fixturePolicy.plaintextPublication: Evidence records carry commitments, case ids and outcome counts only, never candidate values, spans or sanitized text.
fixturePolicy.expectations: Identity, sensitivity and action are authored from the family contract and pii-context/v2 at core 79c0a661 before any scan; detector output never edits them.
fixturePolicy.massAssumption: Declared base-rate mass is an explicit assumption per stratum, not an operational prevalence claim; it is never renormalized.
fixturePolicy.sensitiveExamples: Public/global positives are hand-picked arbitrary global-unicast values outside every IANA special-purpose block named by the contract, with no real-world provenance; private, CGNAT, ULA and link-local positives are safe synthetic inputs. None asserts that a host or person exists.
fixturePolicy.reservedControls: Non-sensitive controls use only the contract v1 classes: RFC 5737, RFC 3849, RFC 2544, BMWG, RFC 9637, loopback, unspecified, broadcast, multicast and IPv4-mapped inheritance.
fixturePolicy.publicInfrastructure: Public-infrastructure rows use widely published anycast resolver/NTP addresses as operational identifiers; they are never labelled sensitive by semantics, only by the contract context rule.

derivedFrom.method: Every predecessor case is kept with its id and input. The pre-registered pii-context/v2 revisions become native authored truth in a sensitive stratum on the same axis; population mass is re-declared under v2; new independent cases are appended. No case was added, removed or relabelled from a scan.

removedFromPopulationViews.basis: The 875 contract and #925 decide only a trailing period after an address; detector-families.md mentions a :port suffix only as an analogy, and the #428 interim review recorded this case as contract-silent. It keeps no declared mass until the contract states the port rule.

retiredStrata.basis: pii-context/v2 (#924) compares a field label only with the candidates that follow it, so no field-label equidistance remains; all three members are sensitive under v2 (net-v2-forward-field-label). Unassociated dense values are re-authored as net-dense-unassociated.
